criteria.question: How would you approach naming and winning a new category for agent-to-agent finance?
criteria.source_quote: Name and win the category.
criteria.looks_like: A plan for positioning, narrative, and vocabulary that makes the category obvious in hindsight.

criteria.question: How would you build out identity, visual system, voice, motion, and event presence end to end?
criteria.source_quote: Build the brand, end to end.
criteria.looks_like: Ownership of identity, visual system, voice, motion, product surfaces, event presence, swag, and board-ready materials, setting and defending the brand standard.

criteria.question: How do you ensure brand consistency across website, content, social, email, sales collateral, onboarding, and support?
criteria.source_quote: Make every touchpoint feel like us.
criteria.looks_like: A system or process for maintaining brand consistency across every customer touchpoint.

criteria.question: How would you drive press, analyst, podcast, and LinkedIn coverage without paying for placement?
criteria.source_quote: Own earned attention.
criteria.looks_like: A strategy for earned media coverage driven by a story worth covering, not paid placement.

criteria.question: How would you build the founders' positioning, prep, and public platform so they become the people quoted on this topic?
criteria.source_quote: Make our founders unmissable.
criteria.looks_like: A plan for founder positioning, media prep, cadence, and platform-building.

criteria.question: What kinds of launches, dinners, or activations would you create to earn disproportionate attention?
criteria.source_quote: Create moments.
criteria.looks_like: Examples of launches, intimate CFO dinners, or conference activations that earned outsized attention.

criteria.question: How would you lay the groundwork to convert category awareness into named finance accounts?
criteria.source_quote: Turn attention into pipeline.
criteria.looks_like: Early demand generation and ABM groundwork converting awareness into a pipeline of named finance accounts.

criteria.question: Can you describe a brand you built from the ground up, not just a marketing function you ran?
criteria.source_quote: You've built a brand, not just run marketing.
criteria.looks_like: A specific example of a brand shaped from identity through execution, showing what it looked and sounded like before and after.

criteria.question: How do you exercise and defend your taste and creative judgment on brand decisions?
criteria.source_quote: Taste, and the nerve to defend it.
criteria.looks_like: Examples of visual/verbal judgment calls, distinguishing good from nearly-good, and choosing a strong point of view over a safe option.

criteria.question: Tell us about a time you created a category or taught a market something new — what did the market believe before, and after?
criteria.source_quote: You've taught a market something new.
criteria.looks_like: A narrative, launch, or campaign with receipts showing a shift in market belief, not just competitive displacement.

criteria.question: Can you show writing where you translated a hard technical concept into something a CFO would feel in a few sentences?
criteria.source_quote: You write well enough to carry the idea.
criteria.looks_like: Writing samples that make a technical concept emotionally resonant for a senior finance audience in just a few sentences.

criteria.question: What's your experience with multi-stakeholder enterprise buying and long sales cycles?
criteria.source_quote: Enterprise B2B instinct.
criteria.looks_like: Demonstrated understanding of multi-stakeholder buying, long cycles, and how a finance org decides, including familiarity with procurement review.

criteria.question: Give an example of shipping something yourself quickly rather than briefing an agency and waiting.
criteria.source_quote: A builder who ships.
criteria.looks_like: A concrete example of shipping fast independently, e.g., a landing page live by Friday, without waiting on an agency.

criteria.question: How do you use AI tools and agents in your own workflow to multiply your craft?
criteria.source_quote: AI-native by default.
criteria.looks_like: A described roster of tools/agents used for research, design, and production to multiply personal output, not to replace thinking.

criteria.question: How do you take a problem from definition to shipped outcome without being directed, and how do you handle disagreement?
criteria.source_quote: Direct, low-ego, high-ownership.
criteria.looks_like: Examples of taking full ownership of a problem end-to-end and constructively challenging ideas without ego.

criteria.question: Are you able to work from Madrid alongside the founders?
criteria.source_quote: working shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders, from Madrid
criteria.looks_like: Confirmation of willingness/ability to be based in Madrid working closely with the founding team.

criteria.question: Do you have experience marketing to finance leaders or in the CFO/fintech space?
criteria.source_quote: Experience marketing to finance leaders, or in the office-of-the-CFO / fintech space
criteria.looks_like: Prior campaigns or roles targeting finance leaders, office-of-the-CFO, or fintech buyers.

criteria.question: Can you work hands-on in Figma and Webflow, and brief a designer when needed?
criteria.source_quote: Design fluency — you can work in Figma and Webflow yourself, and brief a designer properly when you can't
criteria.looks_like: Direct hands-on examples of working in Figma/Webflow plus experience writing clear creative briefs.

criteria.question: What's your track record in PR, analyst relations, and founder/executive communications?
criteria.source_quote: A track record in PR and analyst relations (in-house or agency-side), and founder/executive communications
criteria.looks_like: Concrete examples of securing press/analyst coverage and managing founder or executive communications.

criteria.question: Do you speak Spanish or German?
criteria.source_quote: Spanish or German
criteria.looks_like: Working proficiency in Spanish or German.
